pageNarrationSegments.title: Home Values
pageNarrationSegments.text: In Lancaster and Quartz Hill, 93536, home prices are down 6% from a year ago, so buyers should negotiate carefully.

pageNarrationSegments.title: Realtor Introduction
pageNarrationSegments.text: colby test test of Test Realtor Group serves Lancaster and Quartz Hill and brings you this October market update with the latest pricing, inventory, and sales data for your neighborhood.

pageNarrationSegments.title: Median sale prices
pageNarrationSegments.text: The median sale price is now $520K, down 6% from a year ago and up 3.9% from five years ago. For buyers, that makes budgets easier to test against recently completed sales.

pageNarrationSegments.title: Price per square foot
pageNarrationSegments.text: Price per square foot is now $257, down 2.1% from a year ago. Buyers comparing homes of similar size and condition can use this to judge whether a price is reasonable.

pageNarrationSegments.title: Available homes
pageNarrationSegments.text: There are 492 homes available now, down 9.9% from a year ago and down 25.1% from five years ago. Buyers have a smaller selection to choose from, so comparing options quickly matters.

pageNarrationSegments.title: Median days on market
pageNarrationSegments.text: The median days on market is 54, down 5.3% from a year ago. Sellers can use that figure to plan a marketing timeline, though it is not a promised sale date.

pageNarrationSegments.title: Homes sold
pageNarrationSegments.text: A total of 186 homes sold in the 3 months ending October, down 14.3% from a year ago. Sellers can use these completed sales as evidence when reviewing their asking price.

pageNarrationSegments.title: Sales above, at and below asking
pageNarrationSegments.text: Above asking was the largest sales group, more common than last year.
pageNarrationSegments.takeaway: Sales above, at and below asking

pageNarrationSegments.title: Local happenings
pageNarrationSegments.text: Los Angeles County broke ground October 3 on a reimagined Charles White Park in Altadena, with an inclusive playground, splash pad, lighted pickleball courts, and a new recreation center planned for the five-acre park.

pageNarrationSegments.title: Sale-to-list percentage
pageNarrationSegments.text: Homes are selling for about 0.8% under their final asking price. Sellers should expect some room for negotiation, and buyers may find an opening to offer slightly below asking.
